display_long_description:
Talbica is a visual chemistry app that combines a full periodic table, compounds database, and reactions reference into a single interactive experience. It is designed for students, educators, and anyone interested in understanding chemistry through visualization rather than memorization.

The periodic table includes more than 50 properties for each element, from basic attributes like atomic weight and oxidation states to advanced data such as ionization energies, spectral lines, and half-life. Data is presented with clear structure and visual heatmaps across periods and groups.

All elements are available as detailed 3D models that can be explored in Augmented Reality. Place elements in your environment, examine their physical form, and view them from any angle in real scale.

Talbica also features an animated Bohr atomic model and interactive electron orbital visualizations, helping to understand atomic structure and quantum concepts that are difficult to grasp from static images.

The app includes a large compounds database with key physical and chemical properties, as well as a reactions reference with thousands of balanced chemical reactions and their conditions.

Talbica replaces static textbooks with an intuitive, visual, and immersive way to explore chemistry.
